feedback.note: Live FieldBook Sync Feedback Tracker Intake plus SurveySync Error Log Tracker Dashboard/Errors/Retry Queue checked before 9.4.0 release-candidate preparation.

release_constraints: Versioned release-candidate branch must pass the shared Windows quality gate before Beta publication.
Beta tag must be pre-created at the exact tested release-candidate SHA.
GitHub SurveySync Release workflow must rerun the shared gate, rebuild both native launchers, compile the installer, and create SHA-256.
Installed Windows/WebView acceptance is required before Stable promotion.
Stable promotion must reuse the exact tested Beta installer/hash rather than rebuild.
QGIS, GRASS, laspy, PDAL, and Trimble conversion components remain optional external capabilities.
Real field-positive and field-negative rod-height datasets remain required for production calibration.
Authenticode and cryptographically signed update manifests are not configured.
